external_entities.name: other teams' backends
external_entities.description: Backends operated by other teams that call the inference gateway.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Other teams' backends call our inference gateway

external_entities.name: ML engineers
external_entities.description: Engineers who publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
external_entities.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.

processes.name: inference gateway
processes.description: A FastAPI service on GKE that receives inference requests and forwards them to the model server.
processes.source_excerpt: our inference gateway, a FastAPI service on GKE
processes.notes: Keys are issued per calling team and have never been expired.

processes.name: model server
processes.description: The service that runs the actual model on GPU nodes and reads model artifacts and customer features.
processes.source_excerpt: the model server, which runs the actual model on GPU nodes in our model network
processes.notes: The source says artifact integrity is not verified: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: model registry bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which the model server loads model artifacts at startup.
data_stores.source_excerpt: model artifacts from a model registry bucket
data_stores.notes: The source says artifact integrity verification is uncertain: "I don't believe anything verifies the artifact hasn't been swapped — we just trust the bucket."

data_stores.name: Redis feature store
data_stores.description: A Redis store containing customer features including account age and spend bands per customer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a Redis feature store on the same network. Redis has no password on it
data_stores.notes: The source says Redis is only reachable inside the model network.

data_stores.name: inference log
data_stores.description: A BigQuery log containing every request and response, including raw prompts that users typed.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery
data_stores.notes: The log contains raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.

data_flows.name: call inference
data_flows.description: Other teams' backends call the inference gateway and pass an API key in a header.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Callers pass an API key in a header.

data_flows.name: forward request
data_flows.description: The inference gateway forwards requests to the model server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway forwards the request to the model server
data_flows.notes: There is no authentication between the gateway and the model server.

data_flows.name: load artifacts
data_flows.description: The model server loads model artifacts from the model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The model server loads model artifacts from a model registry bucket at startup.
data_flows.notes: The model server uses its own service account for this. Artifact integrity verification is uncertain.

data_flows.name: read features
data_flows.description: The model server reads customer features from the Redis feature store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the model server reads from a Redis feature store
data_flows.notes: Redis has no password on it.
data_flows.data_description: customer features including account age and spend bands per customer

data_flows.name: write inference log
data_flows.description: The gateway writes every request and response to the inference log for debugging.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway writes every request and response into an inference log in BigQuery, for debugging.
data_flows.notes: The logged requests include raw prompts, which sometimes carry whatever the calling team's users typed.
data_flows.data_description: every inference request and response, including raw prompts

data_flows.name: publish artifacts
data_flows.description: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: ML engineers publish new model artifacts to the registry bucket.
data_flows.notes: The source is uncertain about who can push: "I'm not sure what governs who can push — I think it is a shared group account."

trust_boundaries.name: model network
trust_boundaries.description: The network in which the model server runs; the source says Redis is only reachable inside this network and it is meant to be reachable only from the gateway.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the model network is meant to be reachable only from the gateway
trust_boundaries.notes: The model server is explicitly placed in this network. The source does not explicitly place Redis there.

assumptions.assumption: The inference gateway presents a web interface because it is described as a FastAPI service.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the component as a FastAPI service, which presents an HTTP application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The customer features in the Redis feature store are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the features include account age and spend bands per customer; these are customer-related and financially sensitive contents.
